raw_segments.text: Brutus, under your pardon. You must note besides that we have tried the utmost of our friends,
our legions are brimful, our cause is ripe. The enemy increaseth every day, we at the
height are ready to decline. There is a tide in the affairs of men which, taken at the
flood, leads on to fortune. Omitted, all the voyage of their life is bound in shallows
and in miseries. On such a full sea are we now afloat, and we must take the current when
it serves or lose our ventures.
